item.description: 📰 News 🚫 IEEE no longer accepts Lena image containing submissions from 4/1 onward
item.content:encoded:
📰 News​

🚫 IEEE no longer accepts Lena image containing submissions from 4/1 onward ​

Playboy chose not to sue over the iconic Lena Forsén photo, instead deciding to "exploit this ... phenomenon." Looks like even Playboy is supportive of engineering progress – after all, they know a good model when they see one!

🔒 OpenAI deems its voice cloning tool too risky for general release ​

OpenAI voices concern over risky voice cloning tool. Beware of AI prank calls from "celebrities" and politicians! I once tried to clone my dog's bark - ended up sounding like a malfunctioning robot. #BarkingMadAI

🌍 Nvidia Is Simulating a Copy of the Earth ​

Move aside Earth-1, Earth-2 is here! Nvidia is playing Sims with the planet, creating a digital twin for weather predictions. Next up: "Nvidia Weather Forecast Simulator - now featuring sunny spells with a chance of GPU showers!"

📚 Amazon Kindle Lock Screens Are Showing Ads for AI-Generated Books ​

Amazon Kindles now flooded with AI-generated books, turning lock screens into spam billboards. Soon, your bedtime story might just be "The Boy and the Monsters Meet the AI Robot in the Magical Forest." Who needs sleep anyway?

🐉 Scientists link elusive human group to 150k-year-old Chinese 'dragon man' ​

It's like a genetic family reunion! Denisovans, Neanderthals, and us, Homo sapiens, all mingling and interbreeding like it's a prehistoric dating app. Next stop: Denisovans' adaptation secrets for high altitudes uncovered, turns out their genes are the original mountain climbers!

🍴 Why AWS, Google and Oracle Are Backing the Valkey Redis Fork ​

AWS, Google, and Oracle back Valkey Redis fork because of a licensing tango that left them out in the cold. It's like a playground game of tag gone wrong, with the big cloud players having to rally behind a new friend to keep playing.

🚇 NYC will test Evolv AI gun detectors on the subway ​

New York City subway to test AI gun detectors - sounds like a plot twist in a sci-fi movie! With Evolv under investigation, will the scanners flag even more unusual items as weapons? Beware of your dangerous umbrellas and lunchboxes on your commute!

🌐 Amazon builds Olympus AI model to compete with Anthropic, OpenAI ​

Amazon is in a frenzied AI race with its big bet on Anthropic. They're investing billions to outsmart Microsoft and even have a model codenamed Olympus! If only Jeff Bezos could time travel and buy Anthropic outright, they wouldn't be in this mess!

☠️ Postmortem of the day​

💥 Skyliner. Uncategorized ​

A memory leak in a third party library lead to Skyliner being unavailable on two occasions.

💡📚 Articles​

☁ AWS CloudFormation (3 min read)​

AWS CloudFormation: Making tech wizards' dreams come true with infrastructure as code! Say goodbye to manual errors and hello to automated bliss. It's like having a personal assistant for your cloud setup, only less chatty and more YAML-savvy. Cheers to easy teardowns and reliable builds!

🏢 What does AWS Cloud Architect do? (2 min read)​

Why did the AWS Cloud Architect break up with their partner? They said they needed "space" but couldn't specify if it was on-premises or on the cloud! These architects sure know how to scale up relationships while balancing priorities like a pro.

💪 Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud): Empowering Scalable Cloud Computing (3 min read)​

Amazon EC2, the superhero of cloud computing: fighting traffic spikes, battling cost woes, and flexing its elasticity muscles. With a diverse range of instances, it's the Swiss Army knife of virtual servers. It's like having a cloud genie granting your computing wishes!

💥 3 Most Exciting Features in Java 22 (3 min read)​

Java 22 has unlocked new levels of excitement with features like unnamed variables and patterns. Now you can code with more pizzazz and less clutter! It's like giving your code a decluttering makeover – Spark joy in your coding life!

🚀 App of the Day​

🚀 Salieri’s Multiverse ​

Transform ideas into epics – AI enhanced story creation. Salieri’s Multiverse.ai is an AI-powered sandbox that transforms your ideas into multi-agent, interactive, and illustrated adventures. Craft and share captivating narratives with ease, blending creativity with cutting-edge technology.

item.title: Welcome
item.description: Docusaurus blogging features are powered by the blog plugin.
item.content:encoded:
Docusaurus blogging features are powered by the blog plugin.

Simply add Markdown files (or folders) to the blog directory.

Regular blog authors can be added to authors.yml.

The blog post date can be extracted from filenames, such as:

  • 2019-05-30-welcome.md
  • 2019-05-30-welcome/index.md

A blog post folder can be convenient to co-locate blog post images:

The blog supports tags as well!

And if you don't want a blog: just delete this directory, and use blog: false in your Docusaurus config.
